query:
INSERT INTO job_queue (
                    job_type,
                    organization_id,
                    payload,
                    priority,
                    max_attempts,
                    timeout_seconds,
                    next_run_at,
                    workflow_step_id,
                    stage
                 )
                 VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6, now(), $7, $8)
                 RETURNING id, run_number
